title: LIVE PRECIPITATION — Continental Coverage
freshness: LIVE / CURRENT OBSERVATION (NEXRAD + ECCC NA radar, 5-6 min mosaic)
noaa_source: Iowa Environmental Mesonet CONUS NEXRAD N0Q base reflectivity (NOAA WSR-88D) inside its domain + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) outside it + ECCC GDPS 15km PrecipRate worldwide model fill (Global only)
product_name: Iowa Environmental Mesonet CONUS NEXRAD N0Q base reflectivity (NOAA WSR-88D) inside its domain + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) outside it + ECCC GDPS 15km PrecipRate worldwide model fill (Global only)
variable: N0Q base reflectivity dBZ (IEM domain gaps); ECCC precipitation-rate rain (mm/h)/snow (cm/h) mapped to dBZ through the ECCC 14-color class rates with the NWS Z=300R^1.4 equivalence (equal ECCC colors = equal severity = equal dBZ for rain and snow). One 5-75 dBZ key for both sources.
units: dBZ (both sources on the original N0Q key)
spatial_resolution_source: IEM ~1km CONUS mosaic 5-min (native rendering); ECCC 1km NA composite 6-min (rates -> dBZ via NWS Z=300R^1.4); canvas 3300x1600 (0.05 deg/px)
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: ECCC wins where RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV is transparent (verified authoritative coverage); IEM N0Q fills ECCC gaps natively; 10-px cross-fade on the coverage edge; transparent elsewhere; never zero-filled.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
legend_scale_html: Precipitation intensity (NEXRAD N0Q base reflectivity, dBZ, OBSERVED radar echo): LOWEST 5 Very Light cyan/blue (drizzle, mist) → Light greens (~20-30: light rain/snow) → Moderate dark green (~30-40: steady rain/snow) → Heavy yellow/orange (~40-50: heavy rain) → Severe red (~50-60: severe storms, hail possible) → Intense magenta/purple (~60-70: violent storms, large hail) → HIGHEST+ 70+ Extreme white (destructive hail, debris). Same dBZ always shows the same color in every season — rain, snow, lake-effect snow, thunderstorms. No echo (no precipitation) stays see-through so the map underneath shows.

na_bounds.note: Authoritative common geography for the GLOBAL coverage variant of the four live gradients (wind_na, precipitation_na, cloud_cover_na, air_temperature_na). Same 0.10 deg/px grid as aurora_global. Basin + North America variants keep their existing canvases; only the former extended200 variant moves here. Areas without valid source data stay transparent.
